run_IndexFlat_knn_search: run a k-NN search on an IndexFlat index with L2 or inner product metric
run_IndexFlat_range_search: run a range search on an IndexFlat index to find all vectors within a given radius
run_IndexIVFPQ_approximate_search: run an approximate nearest neighbor search using IndexIVFPQ with product quantization
run_IndexIVFFlat_search: run a search on an IndexIVFFlat index with configurable nprobe for inverted file lookup
run_IndexScalarQuantizer_search: run a search on an IndexScalarQuantizer with 4bit, 8bit, fp16, or bf16 quantization
